Message:
drm/amd/display: disable seamless boot for VSC_SDP

[WHY]
VBIOS will not enable VSC_SDP during pre-OS to lead
MISC1[6] wasn't matched with driver.

[HOW]
disabled seamless boot if sink supports VSC_SDP
